ai_summary_zh: 本場區包含約2520.4平方公尺的瀝青混凝土道路與公園人行步道，鋪面狀況良好且無水域分佈。場內共有39株都市喬木，平均胸高直徑（DBH）為23.2公分，並設有總面積約916.6平方公尺的建築與擋土牆結構。
ai_summary_en: The site features 2520.4 m2 of paved asphalt roads and park walkways in good condition, with no water bodies present. There are 39 urban trees with a mean DBH of 23.2 cm, alongside 916.6 m2 of building and retaining wall structures.
